findings.summary: IC power pin U3.4 (VDDIO) has no DC path to a power rail (net 'LPS_VDD')
findings.description: Pin U3.4 (VDDIO) is type=power_in on net 'LPS_VDD'. Graph walk (≤2 hops, rejecting capacitor edges, accepting resistors≤1Ω, inductors, ferrite beads, bridged solder jumpers) did not reach a named power rail. The pin is likely AC-coupled to ground only — the IC will not power up reliably.
findings.recommendation: Verify the schematic for this pin: the DC route must go through a conducting element (direct wire, 0Ω resistor, inductor, ferrite bead, or bridged solder jumper) — not a capacitor. If the intent was to tie VCC through an LC filter, add the missing inductor or 0Ω in series.

report_context.impact: IC supply floats DC; board will not run.

findings.summary: SPI device U1: CS pin (AT25_nCS) missing pull-up
findings.description: SPI CS on U1 (724-AT25FF321A-UUN-T) net AT25_nCS has no pull-up. Device may be inadvertently selected during reset.

fix_params.basis: SPI CS should be pulled high when not driven

report_context.impact: Device may be selected during reset causing bus contention

findings.summary: U2 pin INT2 (__unnamed_14) missing pull-up resistor
findings.description: Pin INT2 on U2 (ADXL367BCCZ-RL7) is connected to net __unnamed_14 but has no pull-up resistor. This pin type typically requires an external pull-up to a power rail for correct operation.
findings.recommendation: Add a 4.7k-10k pull-up resistor from __unnamed_14 to the appropriate power rail.

fix_params.basis: Pin INT2 is open-drain/input type requiring pull-up

report_context.impact: Pin may float or bus may not function without pull-up

findings.description: Net VBAT carries power_in pins but has no power_out pin, no PWR_FLAG, no regulator output mapping, and no bridged solder jumper path to a sourced net.
findings.recommendation: Add a PWR_FLAG to declare the rail as externally powered (e.g. from a connector) or trace the rail back to a regulator output. If the source lives on another sheet, promote the net name to a global label.

report_context.impact: Rail has no source visible to the analyser; likely a wiring gap or missing PWR_FLAG.

project_config.name: BitPresTagBMP585
project_config.notes: Renamed from BitPresTagBMP581 to BitPresTagBMP585 on 2026-09-04 to match the part actually fitted: U3 is a BMP585 (8-pin metal-lid LGA plus L/M pad, footprint LGA9_BMP585_BOS), not the 10-pin BMP581. Directory, all project files and every internal reference were renamed together; archive/ was deliberately left under the old name as a historical snapshot.
